_about: E1 retrieval query set — leak-resistant 'design-intent' queries (user language, NOT restatements of the PDK docstrings). gold = domain-correct PDK module(s) for the intent, ARM-INDEPENDENT (not the pipeline's own selection). Sourced from the 4 GETTING_STARTED worked examples (gold confirmed by their 2_CS.txt) plus unambiguous single-type intents over the 34-cell DemoPDK. DRAFT — gold sets need Poon-group sign-off before any number is treated as final; some (VOA->pindiode, phase-shifter->heaters) are judgment calls flagged in 'note'.
